JOINT SETTLEMENT MEMO FILED BY THE PARTIES IN THE ABOVE MOTOR ACCIDENTS CLAIMS APPEAL SETTLING THE APPEAL
The above appeal is against award in OP MV.
No.375/2021 dated.13/12/2024 of the motor Accident Claims Tribunal,kottayam
. The original claims is one U/S 166 of the Motor Vehicles Act for the injuries sustained by the appellant in the motor vehicle accident occurred on 15/11/2020..
The learned tribunal after finding negligence on the insured vehicle awarded a compensation of Rs:5,11,477/- with 7% interest and proportionate cost from the 3" respondent insurance Company.
Dissatisfied with the quantum the claimant i is in appeal.

----
The appellant and the 3 respondent Reliance General Insurance Company had discussed the matter on 17/10/2025 held in the high court of Kerala.

Fhe -- appellant has agreed to receive Rs:
1,50,000/-(one lakh fifty thousand only)including interest in addition to the compensation already award by the Tribunal as full and final settlement of the all claims in the appeal.
The respondent insurer has agreed to deposit the above amount in the account of appellant.
The appellant shall furnish the bank account particulars of the appellant within Cc one month from the date of the judgment .The
respondent shall deposit the amount within two month from the date of the receipt of the account particulars.
Incase the insurer fail to deposit the amount after receiving the account particulars of the account particulars as stipulated above the amount shall carry interest as 12% after the late of default.
5, at ERAL WWSURANCE CO. LTD.
